title: Major modernization — Dark mode, Clients, Recurring, Notifications, Advanced analytics & Goals
summary: A large modernization pass covering architecture refactoring, dark mode, client management, recurring services, in-app notifications, period-over-period analytics comparisons, revenue goal tracking, and client retention insights.
changes: Notifications: Automatic alerts for overdue recurring services and low-stock products (3 or fewer remaining) — refreshed on every data change.
Analytics: Period comparison — the four summary stat cards on the Analytics page now show percentage change arrows comparing the selected date range against the preceding period of equal length.
Analytics: New client retention chart showing new versus returning clients month by month.
Analytics: New top clients by revenue leaderboard on the Analytics page.
Goals: New Goal model with revenue, service count, or product sale count targets scoped weekly or monthly, optionally per worker.
Goals: Goal progress bars appear on the Dashboard with color indicators (blue → amber → green) and target-reached badges.
Goals: Full CRUD for goals via the data store with schema v4 migration.
Data schema upgraded to v4 with automatic migration from all older versions.
